stack.program: ns3/scratch/cmwave/e15-link-validation.cc: mode beams added; mode nrfading gains --gnbBeam=cb|eig (default dp, unchanged); modes link and chan unchanged (check R1)

source_facts: three-gpp-spectrum-propagation-loss-model.cc (ns-3 d083a17a): rx PSD on RB i = tx PSD x |sum_c LT_c exp(-j 2 pi f_i tau_c) doppler_c|^2 with LT_c = sum_{u,s} conj(w_u) H(u, s, c) w_s; with one UE element (w_u = 1) and the gNB on side s this is |sum_n w_n h_i[n]|^2, h_i[n] = sum_c H(0, n, c) exp(-j 2 pi f_i tau_c)

the Doppler factor is exp(j 2 pi t f / c (...)) with t = Simulator::Now(): exactly 1 at t = 0 (mode beams) and 1 at every t for static nodes with the default vScatt = 0 (V0 and the NR smoke run agree to 1e-12 dB at t > 0)
UniformPlanarArray element n sits at (y', z') = (dH (n mod cols), dV floor(n / cols)) in the panel frame, rotated by the bearing (GetElementLocation)

ThreeGppChannelModel keeps the cluster parameters per node pair and the channel matrix per antenna pair; changing a beamforming vector recomputes only the long-term component, never the channel (GetLongTerm, UpdatePeriod 0)

NR IdealBeamformingHelper runs the beamforming task at attach and then every BeamformingPeriodicity (default 100 ms); BeamManager::SaveBeamformingVector stores a per-UE vector that NrGnbPhy installs before each DL data transmission to that UE (nr-gnb-phy.cc ChangeBeamformingVector)

ns-3 Angles(v) sets the azimuth to WrapToPi(atan2(y, x)), which TRUNCATES it to a grid of 2 pi / 1e11 rad (int64 conversion, src/antenna/model/angles.cc); NR's DirectPath vector therefore points up to 6.3e-11 rad in azimuth away from the exact direction (phase error <= 2 pi x array size x 6.3e-11 < 1e-8 rad, gain change < 2e-8 dB). Check I4 mirrors this quantization; the difference to the exact geometric direction is reported

NrGnbPhy changes the analog beam at most once per time instant ('if (Simulator::Now() > m_lastBfChange)', nr-gnb-phy.cc): UEs co-scheduled in the same symbols get the first UE's beam (relevant to the OFDMA item, not used here: all NR runs are TDMA)
hazard_13: ns-3.48 UMa with LOS and O2I: GetThreeGppTable selects the O2I table (6x6 LSP correlation, uK = sigK = 0) whenever O2I is set, but GenerateLSPs still treats the link as LOS (7 parameters, order SF, K, DS, ASD, ASA, ZSD, ZSA), so the O2I correlation matrix is read in the wrong order with a zero 7th row (ZSA becomes deterministic), and a LOS ray with K = 0 dB is added. LOS + O2I is therefore never used; mode beams aborts on it
geometry: configs/e1/positions_munich_tx0.json: gNB (8.5, 21.0, 27.0), the 27 UE positions at 1.5 m, geometric class from E1.1 (9 LOS, 18 NLOS)
serving_sector: E1.4 rule: cmwave.radio.antenna.gnb_gain_dbi (largest element gain; bearings 30/150/270 deg)

strata.o2o: prescribed condition = E1.1 geometric class, O2O (LOS 9, NLOS 18)
strata.o2i: all 27 positions with condition NLOS + O2I: ns-3's UMa O2I table (12 clusters, no specular ray, ZSD and ZOD offset of NLOS form); positions labelled by the geometric class of the outdoor path for reporting. O2I penetration loss is a large-scale loss and does not enter the gain metric, so low- and high-loss buildings are one stratum for the gain; they differ only in the link budget (E1.5.5)

arrays.common: TR 38.901 Table 7.3-1 element (ThreeGppAntennaModel OUTDOOR: 8 dBi, 65/65 deg, 30 dB), 0.5 lambda spacing both ways, mechanical downtilt 0, single (vertical) polarization, one port: all elements carry one analog beam; aperture A = 4 x 8 wavelengths (vertical x horizontal), B = 8 x 16 wavelengths; B at 7.2 GHz (0.33 x 0.67 m) has about the physical aperture of A at 3.5 GHz (0.34 x 0.69 m), the E1.4 equal-aperture regime

ue_antenna: 1x1 isotropic (the gNB term only; UE arrays are E1.5.2b)
channel: TR 38.901 UMa (ns-3.48 ThreeGppChannelModel, pre-Release-19 fast-fading tables), 20 MHz, 30 kHz SCS, 51 RBs (RbOverhead 0.073), UpdatePeriod 0, no blockage, static nodes; mode beams applies no path loss or shadowing (gain only)

rng.common_random_numbers: all runs of one stratum use the same streams, so their realizations share random variates; ns-3 draws the cluster parameters independently of the element count, so arrays A and B at 7.2 GHz see the same clusters per realization (reported: identical n_clusters sequences). The two carriers are NOT correlated as in TR 38.901 cl. 7.6.5; carrier comparisons are paired by position only

beams.dp: NR CreateDirectPathBfv toward the geometric gNB-UE direction: w = exp(-j 2 pi r.d) / sqrt(N). Geometric steering, not an oracle in NLOS
beams.cb: oversampled 2D DFT codebook, Oh = Ov = 4: (4 cols) x (4 rows) beams (2048 for A, 8192 for B), w[row cols + col] = exp(-j 2 pi (col p / (4 cols) + row q / (4 rows))) / sqrt(N), the form of the TS 38.214 Type I DFT beams; selection = argmax of the mean RB gain with exact channel knowledge (ORACLE codebook selection: no measurement noise, no sweep overhead); DirectPath is not a candidate
beams.cb1: best beam of the orthogonal subgrid (p mod 4 = 0, q mod 4 = 0: cols x rows beams), same rule
beams.eig: unconstrained_single_beam_bound: largest eigenvalue of R = (1/K) sum_i conj(h_i) h_i^T, the maximum of w^H R w over unit-norm frequency-flat w (any amplitudes); computed by power iteration on the 51 x 51 Gram matrix with a Cholesky certificate (lambda_max <= (1 + 1e-9) mu); its eigenvector is installed in ns-3 (and in NR for V1); not achievable with constant-modulus phase shifters
beams.eigpo: phase-only version of the computed principal beam, exp(j arg w) / sqrt(N): a constant-modulus beam built from exact CSI (reported, not a bound)
beams.mrt: (1/K) sum_i ||h_i||^2: per-RB matched filter, the ceiling of any frequency-selective single-stream digital precoder with exact CSI (reported)

gain_definition: g = sum over the 51 RBs of rx PSD / sum of the flat tx PSD (the E1.5.2-0 chan definition) = mean over RBs of the beamformed channel power gain, element pattern included; G = 10 log10 g
e14_reference: G_E1.4(p) = cmwave.radio.antenna.gnb_gain_dbi: element gain + 10 log10 N toward the geometric direction, serving sector (ideal steering)
n1_settings: mode chan (unchanged since E1.5.2-0), isotropic 1x1 gNB and UE, role s, weights dp, 200 copies, RngRun 2

nr_runs.per_config: one run per sector bearing (30, 150, 270 deg) with the UEs that sector serves

settings.beamforming: IdealBeamformingHelper with DirectPath at attach, BeamformingPeriodicity = simTime + 100 s; then the channel-computed beam (cb or eig, from the channel generated before the run in the DL direction) is saved per UE with BeamId (ue_index + 1, 0)
settings.other: E1.5.1 / E1.5.2-0 common settings (44 dBm, NF 5/7 dB, RbOverhead 0.073, numerology 1, DDDSU); no UL traffic

statistics.per_position: for position p, beam x, run: G_x(p) = median over the 200 realizations of 10 log10 g_x (primary); also 10 log10 of the mean linear gain, and the 5th and 95th percentiles over realizations
statistics.paired_beams: Delta_{x,y}(p) = median over realizations of [10 log10 g_x - 10 log10 g_y] on the same realization, for (cb, dp), (eig, cb), (eig, dp), (mrt, eig), (cb, cb1), (eig, eigpo)
statistics.paired_configs: by position: D_x(p; a, 7.2 GHz) - D_x(p; a, 3.5 GHz) and D_x(p; b, 7.2 GHz) - D_x(p; a, 7.2 GHz), each stratum
statistics.strata: O2O LOS (9 positions), O2O NLOS (18), O2I (27, also split by geometric class)
statistics.summary: median over the positions of a stratum, with a 95% percentile bootstrap CI: positions resampled with replacement within the stratum, 2000 resamples, numpy default_rng(15211); positions, not realizations, are the independent units
statistics.reported: all 27 per-position values for every run and beam; Spearman correlation of D_x(p) with the 2D distance per stratum (descriptive); selected codebook beam directions; run time and peak memory

decision_rules.instrument_valid: R1, S1, I1-I4, D1, N1 and V1 pass -> the measured gains are the E1.5.2-1 result
decision_rules.gain_model_for_e1_5_5_and_e1c: regimes A and B: G_used(p) = G_E1.4(p) - D_cb[stratum, carrier, array], D_cb = the stratum median deficit of the DFT codebook beam (primary: a deployable analog beam choice, selected here with exact CSI); sensitivities: D_dp (geometric steering, lower) and D_eig (frequency-flat bound, upper); the bootstrap CI of D_cb is carried as uncertainty. Strata: O2O LOS, O2O NLOS, O2I
decision_rules.regime_c: not measured here (1024 elements, 200 MHz; cost test first); E1.4's S3 assumption (4.5 dB NLOS loss) stays labelled as an assumption
decision_rules.no_minimum_gain: no minimum improvement of cb over dp is required; zero or negative values are valid results
decision_rules.artefact: the 33-36 dB receive-side DirectPath loss of E1.5.2-0 is an implementation artefact and is never used as a physical gain
decision_rules.stop: any check fails -> stop and diagnose before any gain is used; failed evidence is kept; no threshold is changed and no failed check is removed

out_of_scope: UE arrays (E1.5.2b); dual polarization and multi-port/multi-stream precoding; beam-sweep overhead, measurement noise and CSI ageing; mobility; best-sector selection (the E1.4 serving sector is kept); Release-19 fast-fading tables; regime C; spatial consistency; TR 38.901 cl. 7.6.5 cross-frequency correlation; area-representative coverage (E1c)
